wholePhysicalScope: The circa-1895 limestone church envelope, its tall front tower and copper spire, near-grade doors and rounded apse with oculi.
lodDetails: Four levels preserve the copper spire, rose and portals, six-bay nave and rounded apse. Near levels show rose tracery, louvres, window reveals and copper seams.
limitations: The single circa-1895 stereograph shows the main front through trees. Unseen side and apse details follow the building inventory and mapped envelope. Stone and copper colors are estimates.
The church and spire use the documented material and overall proportions. Precise tracery, statues and small ornaments are simplified.
The original composite elevation field was retained. The historic ground registration is approximate.
The reconstruction covers the church and attached porch. The adjacent buildings, garden, fence and detached gate are outside the modeled footprint.
